changelog:
- Initial release of product-name-extractor.
- Precisely extracts only product names from user-provided text.
- Ignores all irrelevant content, including descriptions, prices, or reviews.
- Outputs each detected product name on a separate line.
- Returns "No product names detected" if none are found.
summary: Precisely extract product names from user-provided text, ignoring all irrelevant information and outputting only the product names.
